OAT-03/S09.title: Haiku hangs to its 20 s deadline on Ask AI, Mistral answers; the log puts the 20 s on the AI service (5 Hospital + 5 Nursing Home)
OAT-03/S09.detail: Runtime half, in-process (rst-oat03-s09-haiku-hang.spec.ts): the real convex/ai/assist.ts askChart handler (aiAction wrapper, chat(), runWithRetry, timeProviderCall, the diagnostics and audit writes) with only ctx.runAction (the bedrock.invoke hop) stubbed: Haiku rejects with an AbortError exactly at its attempt deadline (the SDK's behaviour), Mistral answers from the medication lines it was sent. Contexts built by the app's own Ask AI builder (buildAskContext + classifyQuery) from the matrix fixtures QA Hosp Okafor (Metoprolol active, Lisinopril held) and QA Resident Brooks (Acetaminophen); 10 questions in parallel. 60/60 judged checks pass: every answer names the medications on file (Metoprolol, Lisinopril, held / acetaminophen) and Mistral's request carried the whole chart context; every assist.askChart row has model = mistral.mistral-large-3-675b-instruct, fellBackFrom = us.anthropic.claude-haiku-4-5-20251001-v1:0, ok, providerMs 20001-20003 (>= 20000: the hung attempt is counted as the AI service's time) and durationMs - providerMs = 1-3 ms (<= 2000); the ai_disclosure audit row says the same (provider_ms >= 20000). Recorded only: Q4 — Haiku was asked once, not twice (retry.ts skips the second try when the first took >= 10 s; Mistral got the remaining ~10 s, attempt timeout 9 999 ms); question-to-answer 20.0 s (under 30 s, Q6). No backend, no browser, no vendor.
